Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-call: Procurement readiness & MPA next steps (AcmeCloud)

Hi Elena / Sam - thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Summary: Great discovery call. AcmeCloud is aligned on technical fit for Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) for your inference workloads; main gating factors are procurement (paper process) and security review cadence.

- Open procurement questions we covered: PO vs card payment, marketplace vs direct contract, typical legal review timelines, and required security artifacts (SOC 2, encryption attestation, audit logs).

Proposed next steps (dates are placeholders - happy to adjust):
1) We share a draft Mutual Action Plan (MPA) outlining milestones (legal review, security review, finance/PO) - action: Marissa to share (today).
2) AcmeCloud to confirm preferred commercial path (PO through finance or marketplace purchase) - action: Elena / Sam (by 2026-03-26).
3) Redwood to provide PO template and SOC2 evidence pack - action: Marcus / Camila (by 2026-03-24).
4) 30-min MPA check-in to align owners and ETA for PO issuance - proposed: 2026-03-26 10:00 PT.

Attachments: MPA_AcmeCloud_v1.xlsx (draft), redwood-sow-v1.pdf (standard SOW).

If that matches your read, please confirm preferred payment path (PO vs card) and whether your procurement team prefers marketplace procurement (AWS Marketplace) or direct PO.

Thanks -
Marissa
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cope@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Patel <s.patel@acmecloud.com>, Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@acmecloud.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-23T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement readiness & MPA next steps (AcmeCloud)

Thanks Marissa - appreciate the clear summary. A few data points from procurement/finance: 

- Payment preference: We typically issue a PO for reserved capacity purchases > $50k ARR. We can do card for pilot/POC spend under that threshold.
- Marketplace: We prefer marketplace purchases when available (simpler billing and faster procurement) but we need to confirm Redwood's listing and pricing parity; can you confirm if Redwood plans to offer the Dedicated product via AWS Marketplace or similar?
- Timeline: Our legal tends to take 7-10 business days for standard SaaS agreements, security review (infosec) can take 2-3 weeks depending on requested evidence and whether we need a short architecture review. Finance/PO issuance is usually 3-5 business days after legal sign-off.

I'll loop in Rajiv (Finance) who will own PO issuance and Sam (Procurement) who will coordinate legal intake. We can review the MPA but would prefer a column for "owner" and realistic ETA windows.

I'll review the draft MPA and get back with confirmation on internal owners by EOD 2026-03-24.

-Elena
Head of Vendor Ops | AcmeCloud
elena.torres@acmecloud.com

Thanks Elena - appreciate the timing. Marissa, attaching a slightly updated MPA with an "owner" column and conservative ETA ranges. Also attaching our PO template and a zipped SOC 2 evidence index (summary file names only in the attachment list).

Attachments: MPA_AcmeCloud_v1.xlsx, AcmeCloud_PO_Template.pdf, SOC2-Evidence-Index.txt

- Marketplace: We are planning to support AWS Marketplace for Dedicated in Q2; for procurement purposes today the direct PO path is fully supported. If AcmeCloud prefers marketplace to accelerate procurement we'll surface a formal listing ETA and parallel pricing options.
- Legal redlines: For speed, we recommend an initial signature on our standard SOW + order form (short form) and parallel negotiation on longer-term terms if needed.

- Owners: Legal (Sam) / Security (Melissa H., cc'd via separate invite) / Finance (Rajiv). I'll send a calendar invite for a brief intake meeting on 2026-03-26 at 10:00 PT; that's when we'll aim to align on the initial "legal review" and expected sign-off windows.
